sed -n 40,80p README.md; echo ----SWITCH; cat build/esm/components/controls/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; find build/esm -name 'Switch*.d.ts' | head; echo ----SEG; cat build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; echo ----OPT; cat build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; echo ----; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ----; cat theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts; echo ----; cat ../../../package.json | grep -n '"version"'; ls ../../../styles/themes | head; echo ----; grep -rn "root_theme\|g-root" ../../../styles/styles.css | head -5
cat controls/types.d.ts | head -80; echo ----; sed -n 1,40p Switch/Switch.js

Card/Card.d.ts; grep -n "variant\|as?" Text/Text.d.ts | head -8; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -i "jsdom\|happy-dom\|playwright\|testing-library"
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && grep -n "export type TextVariant" -A3 Text/*.d.ts | head; grep -rn "type CardView" Card/*.d.ts
sed -n 1,12p Card/Card.d.ts; grep -rn "variant" Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; grep -rln "TextVariant" ../ --include=*.d.ts | head -3
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -20; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -i "puppeteer\|playwright" ; node -v
mkdir -p /tmp/theme-verify && cd /tmp/theme-verify && npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 170 npm i jsdom@24 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3; ls node_modules | grep -c .

cd /tmp/theme-verify && NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin/esbuild entry.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --jsx=automatic --loader:.css=empty --external:jsdom --log-level=warning --outfile=out.mjs && node out.mjs; echo "exit=$?"

pkill -f /tmp/theme-verify/out.mjs; pkill -f "theme-verify/out.mjs" ; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat && echo ---- && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | head -5; echo "tsc exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if grep -q "theme-verify/out.mjs" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null; then echo "killing ${p#/proc/}"; kill ${p#/proc/} 2>/dev/null; fi; done; sleep 1; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do grep -q "theme-verify/out.mjs" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null && echo "still running ${p#/proc/}"; done; echo done
